policy: Major ordinary English paper sets, at least 50 distinct cards. No set is complete from a profile count. Missing tasks are pending. Foil-only and classification-review printings stay visible. Grouped by frame, color, layout, card kind, legendary treatment and stamp; rarity coverage is explicit within each group.

tasks.references: Reference quality and original printing wording
tasks.normalization: Independent frame translation, scale, rotation/skew validation
tasks.frameGeometry: Frame source, stock/corners, art aperture, boxes and crown geometry
tasks.blackLevels: Interior ink and outer stock, measured separately
tasks.manaGeometry: Cost-disc placement, spacing, glyph and generic-number geometry
tasks.manaColor: Mana-disc and glyph colors, outline/shadow treatment
tasks.setSymbol: Expansion-symbol contour, rarity fills/rims, size and placement
tasks.headings: Name and type fonts, weight, spacing, position and shadows
tasks.rules: Rules size, margins, alignment, line spacing and inline symbols
tasks.flavor: Flavor spacing, divider and attribution alignment
tasks.artist: Illustrator wording, font, size, alignment and shadow
tasks.footer: Copyright, trademarks, collector number and lower information
tasks.stats: Power/toughness or loyalty geometry, typography and shadows
tasks.specialComponents: Basic-land glyph, stamp and layout-specific components
tasks.fullCard: Every-printing native replay, regional/full scores and outlier review
tasks.release: Renderer checks, published revision and matching score revision
